daily_summaries.content: Mike had a normal workday at Community School. He felt healthy, taught classes, returned home in the afternoon, and did not notice any unusual illness around him.

weekly_summaries.content: During the past week, Mike followed his regular teaching routine. He generally complied with school guidance and did not show strong concern about disease risk because there were no confirmed local outbreaks.

monthly_summaries.content: So far in May, Mike has behaved like a cautious but responsible teacher. He values his teaching duties, but his high health awareness makes him more likely to stay home when he notices symptoms.
